title: service-knowledge: a knowledge source that names an unregistered adapter fails silently (boot clean, search answers [], index throws a bare Error)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZmwqAVSYHM1nQUDTq

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · from PR #37477 (#37004) Acceptance notes, measurement (b) the card asked for ("If (b) is silent, say so in the PR and the seat files the enforcement card") · Area: o5-A

## What happens
Measured on PR #37477's head `d3692d0c` (the card thread's readings): a knowledge source whose `adapter` names no registered adapter
- boots clean (one info line only);
- `search` answers `[]` with one warn log, and `searchWithRefusals` answers `refused: []` — the source is not listed as refused;
- `indexDocument` / `reindexSource` throw a bare `Error` with no code or status; event sync swallows it at warn.

`KnowledgeSourceSchema.adapter` is `z.string()` (`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts`), so nothing at publish time refuses an unknown name either. After #37004 retires `ragflow`, every stored source that still says `adapter: 'ragflow'` lands in this path.

## Done when
An unregistered adapter is refused loudly at one named point (publish/`os validate` or boot) with a coded error that names the source and the adapter, `searchWithRefusals` lists the source as refused, and the index paths throw a coded error. Which point refuses is the lane's design call; a pin test covers each.

reach: an author or agent who writes `adapter: 'ragflow'` (taught by the docs until #37004) or mistypes an adapter name; read from PR #37477's measurement.
Business reason: knowledge search that quietly returns nothing looks like "no answer" to the user; the author never learns the source is dead.
Reader: triage → `domain:server` lane (service-knowledge).
Dedupe: `unregistered adapter knowledge`, `unknown adapter knowledge` (open and closed) → #37304 (knowledge_source type and loader, zone ai-37000) is the nearest; it registers published sources but does not refuse an unregistered adapter. If its loader is the natural refusal point, ai-37000 may fold this in.
Grading: area:ai · Bug · suggested p2 (silent wrong result, builders often after the ragflow retirement) · evidence: measured on PR head.
